items.name: Sprout Classic Soon Kueh
items.qualifier: Box selection optional: Box of 2 has no printed extra charge; Box of 4 +S$3.60; Party Platter of 12 +S$18.00. Required pairing: select up to 2 from Sweet Sauce; Fragrant Fried Shredded Cabbage; Sambal Chilli; No Shrimp Chilli (Crispy). Extra sauce optional: each of those four +S$0.50, in addition to 2 complimentary sauces. Merchant states 100% vegetarian and allium-free; dairy milk appears in a beverage so whole venue is vegetarian, not vegan. Food-only source snapshot checked 16 Oct 2026. Availability, preorder lead-time and delivery fees not established by this current page.
